Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7027); Cis (i.e. Kish), an Israelite:--Cis.
BiblicalUsage: Cis is Kish, the father of Saul. Acts 13:21 says that when Israel desired a king, God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Kish is named because Saul's kingship is a family story before it is a national one: the son of Cis was the king Israel asked for, and the king they had to learn from.
